verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms llamafile supports GGUF models (docs-17), which is a quantized model format, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents specific quantization bit-widths (e.g., 2-bit to 8-bit) or a quantization tool/flag. missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported quantization levels/bit-widths, any quantization conversion tooling, and independent confirmation of low-bit quant usage.
